critter.seaBass: I caught a sea bass! No, wait… it's at least a C+!
critter.junk.old-tire: Got one! …Oh. It's an old tire.
critter.junk.empty-can: Got one! …Oh. It's an empty can.

beach.wish: I wished on a shooting star!
beach.note.0: Hope it's sunny where you are!
beach.note.1: A little walk makes a happy day.
beach.note.2: If this reached you, we're friends now!
beach.note.3: I saw dolphins from my island!
beach.note.4: Don't forget to drink some water!
beach.note.7: Don't push too hard. Take it easy!
beach.note.8: What's your next snack going to be?
beach.note.9: The sound of the waves is so calming.
beach.note.10: Tell me one good thing about today!
beach.note.12: With love, from an island far away.
beach.note.13: Have a good stretch before bed!
beach.note.15: Tomorrow will be a good day too.

panel.helpSummary: 1 Bell for each goal you meet, +2 when you both meet all four. Spend them on snacks and eating out.

chat.lazy.0: I'm kinda hungry… did you eat yet?
chat.lazy.2: A slow walk still counts as exercise!
chat.lazy.3: I wonder what today's snack is…
chat.lazy.4: That cloud looks like a rice ball.
chat.lazy.5: I lose track of time watching bugs.
chat.lazy.6: After lazing around, a little stretch!
chat.lazy.7: I kinda like rainy days too.
chat.lazy.8: I'm a slow-and-steady kind of guy.
chat.lazy.9: The waves are making me sleepy…
chat.lazy.10: Catch any fish? They look tasty…
chat.lazy.11: The soft grass feels so nice.
chat.peppy.0: Hiya! I'm full of energy today!
chat.peppy.3: That outfit looks super cute on you!
chat.peppy.8: Can I sing? La la la ♪
chat.peppy.9: The flowers make me so happy!
chat.peppy.11: I'm so excited I can't stand it!
chat.smug.1: A beautiful island deserves a beautiful me.
chat.smug.2: A rose would suit you, you know.
chat.smug.6: I see how hard you're working.
chat.smug.7: I take my tea with lemon, naturally.
chat.smug.8: The starry sky is my stage.
chat.smug.9: Good manners are an island's treasure.
chat.smug.10: I'd rate myself a 70 today. Modest.
chat.smug.11: I put my heart into every step.
chat.cranky.0: Hmph. Not bad weather, I guess.
chat.cranky.2: Don't overdo it. But don't slack off.
chat.cranky.3: Back in my day, we walked everywhere.
chat.cranky.6: Don't skip your stretch before bed.
chat.cranky.7: I'm not a fan of noise.
chat.cranky.8: Early to bed, early to rise. That's it.
chat.cranky.9: The sunsets here aren't half bad.
chat.cranky.10: …I'm NOT lonely. Just so you know.
chat.normal.1: I baked cookies and they turned out great!
chat.normal.2: A walk makes my heart feel lighter.
chat.normal.5: I'm growing so fond of this island.
chat.normal.6: Let's take a break with a warm tea.
chat.normal.7: Thanks for today. It makes me happy.
chat.normal.11: Stay warm when you sleep tonight.
chat.jock.1: Ten squats with me? Let's go!
chat.jock.6: Water after a good sweat? The best!
chat.jock.8: Rest is part of training too!
chat.jock.10: Taking the stairs is great exercise!
chat.snooty.1: Style starts with your shoes, darling.
chat.snooty.2: Walk gracefully and you'll never tire.
chat.snooty.3: This rose's color is just my taste.
chat.snooty.4: One savors sweets, one bite at a time.
chat.snooty.7: A stroll under the stars. Romantic.
chat.snooty.9: That shell would make a fine accessory.
chat.sisterly.1: If you're in a pinch, come to me!
chat.sisterly.2: Tired of walking? Take a breather.
chat.sisterly.4: That's the spirit! I won't lose either!
chat.sisterly.5: Leave the bug catching to me.
chat.sisterly.8: Get to bed. There's always tomorrow.
chat.sisterly.9: It's okay to slack off a bit.
chat.sisterly.10: I'm pretty good at fishing, y'know.
chat.special.7: Everyone knows how hard you two try.
chat.day.morning.0: Morning! Let's make today a good one.
chat.day.morning.1: A morning walk feels so good.
chat.day.night.0: The island's nice at night too.
chat.day.any.1: How are you feeling right now?
chat.day.noneYet: The day's still young! Fancy a walk?
chat.sp.jack.intro:
Happy Halloween!
I am Jack, the Czar of Halloween!
Tonight is a very special, spooky night...
Let's make it frightfully fun!
chat.sp.jack.ask:
Now then... trick or treat!
No candy, and you'll get a trick!
chat.sp.jack.thanks:
Ooh! Candy!
The sweetest joy of Halloween! Thank you!
chat.sp.jack.trick:
What... nothing at all?
Then it's a trick! Heh heh heh...!
chat.sp.jack.0: The sweetness of candy is tonight's magic...
chat.sp.jack.1: Dressing up as a ghost is half the fun of Halloween!
chat.sp.jack.2: The pumpkin lanterns are glowing just right.
chat.sp.kk-slider.0: Hey. Up for a song tonight?
chat.sp.kk-slider.2: Turn the music on and I'll play you one.
chat.sp.kk-slider.3: Saturday nights, you'll find me here.
chat.sp.daisy-mae.2: I only come on Sunday mornings!
chat.sp.daisy-mae.3: Good morning! What a nice day!
chat.sp.wisp.1: The island's so quiet at night…
chat.sp.gulliver.1: I seem to have fallen off my ship…
chat.sp.gulliver.3: My crew should come get me soon!
zukan.title: Critterpedia
zukan.hint: Catch, dig up or pick things up on the island to fill this in!
chat.lazy.0.more: I just had three rice balls.
chat.cranky.5.more: Don't let it go to your head. Hmph.
chat.jock.1.more: One, two, three… Yeah, that's it!
chat.snooty.5.more: Late nights are bad for your skin.
chat.special.0.more: I'll come back to visit soon.
chat.day.any.0.more: Me? I was happy it was sunny!
chat.sp.kk-slider.intro:
Hey, I'm K.K.
Saturday nights, I play here.
Turn the music on
and I'll play you one, anytime.
chat.sp.daisy-mae.intro:
Morning! I'm Daisy Mae!
I sell Grandma's turnips.
Just saying hi today…
See you next Sunday morning!
chat.sp.wisp.intro:
Boo! …Did I scare you?
I'm Wisp. I'm a ghost.
Please don't be scared…
I just love night walks.
chat.sp.franklin.intro:
Happy Turkey Day!
I'm Franklin, the chef.
Today's the day we all sit down
to a big feast together!
chat.sp.franklin.ask:
For my very best dish
I need one fish.
If you catch one, would you
bring it to me?
chat.sp.franklin.thanks:
Oh! A splendid {fish}!
Thank you! Now I can make
the finest feast of all!
chat.sp.franklin.0:
Smells good, doesn't it?
Almost ready!
chat.sp.franklin.1:
Food in season
gives you energy!
chat.sp.franklin.2:
Your fish is going to
taste wonderful!
chat.sp.jingle.intro:
Merry Toy Day!
I'm Jingle!
Tonight's the special night
I deliver presents!
chat.sp.jingle.1:
It's cold out, so stay
warm when you sleep!
chat.sp.jingle.3:
Ho ho! Have a
jolly Toy Day!
chat.sp.pave.intro:
Welcome to Festivale!
I'm Pavé!
Today we dance
the whole day long!
chat.sp.pave.0:
Come on, step it up!
One, two!
chat.sp.pave.2:
Dancing warms the heart
and the body!
chat.sp.zipper.intro:
Hoppy hop!
I'm Zipper!
Let's hunt for
Bunny Day eggs!
chat.sp.zipper.0:
Eggs hide in the ground
and on balloons, hop!
chat.sp.zipper.1:
You might even fish
one up, hop!
chat.sp.zipper.3:
Hop hop! Let's keep
bouncing along!
chat.day.turkey-day.0:
It's Turkey Day!
Something smells good.
chat.day.toy-day.1:
I wonder what the presents are!
So exciting!
chat.day.bunny-day.0:
It's Bunny Day!
Let's hunt for eggs!
chat.sp.celeste.intro:
Oh, good evening!
I'm Celeste. I just love the stars.
There'll be lots of shooting stars tonight!
Let's watch them together.
chat.sp.celeste.0:
When you see a shooting star,
tap the sky and make a wish!
chat.sp.celeste.1:
Wish on one, and tomorrow morning
star fragments wash up on the beach.
chat.sp.celeste.2:
This season's sign is {sign}.
You might find its fragment too!
chat.sp.celeste.3:
Hoo! Did you see that one?
What a lovely shooting star!
chat.sp.gulliver.intro:
…Mmmh… Huh!
What island is this?
I seem to have fallen off my ship…
I'll wait here for my crew.
chat.sp.kk-slider.hello:
Hey, thanks for coming out tonight.
Got a request?
chat.sp.kk-slider.tuning:
Just tuning my guitar right now…
Give me a little while.
